# canary add --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary add — Plan a stock addition or opening and review it through existing
order confirmation

Usage: canary add plan|preview SYMBOL --currency CCY --limit PRICE (--quantity
       N|--max) [--con-id ID] [--stop-price PRICE] [--json]
       canary add market [--json] < request.json
       canary add call-plan [--json] < request.json

Flags
  --adaptive-priority STRING
                            IBKR Adaptive priority for the limit: Normal,
                            Patient, or Urgent
  --con-id INT              exact broker stock identity when known
  --currency STRING         stock trading currency (required)
  --exchange STRING         broker venue (default: SMART)
  --json                    emit typed Add evidence
  --limit FLOAT             maximum price per share in the stock currency
  --max                     find the maximum supported addition for one order
  --quantity INT            exact additional whole shares; choose this or --max
  --stop-price FLOAT        fixed attached stop below entry; added shares only,
                            GTC regular session

plan checks a stock addition or opening; preview creates an exact order review
for separate owner confirmation. Neither places an order.
market reads stock quotes and discovers or refreshes calls; call-plan sizes an
exact call using broker fee evidence. Both read one JSON object from stdin. Run
canary add market --help or canary add call-plan --help for request fields and
examples.
